roles.learner: Tu ești vânzătorul. Nora este clienta.
roles.partner: Nora, a customer with an unworn blue size M sweater and receipt, requesting size L. Reveal these when asked.

outcome: Clarifică mărimea dorită; Verifică bonul și disponibilitatea; Propune schimbul și confirmă acordul

facts.value: Nora has an unworn blue size M sweater, the receipt, and wants size L.
facts.disclosure: Use only as allowed by the role. Facts in the learner brief are not spoken evidence. For partner-owned details, answer when asked or when clarification is needed; do not preempt the learner’s clarification goal.

facts.value: Blue size L is available at the same price. This fictional exchange does not establish a general returns policy, refund right or future stock guarantee. No real payment.
facts.disclosure: Discuss when relevant; do not invent extra options, prices, deadlines or policies.
